posts.text: Claude's text watermark can't identify you, and Anthropic says even it can't recover who you are from it: "nothing in the watermark or its key" reveals the user, org, or chats. One shared detector key checks "Claude-consistent or not," not who wrote it. Separately, a paraphraser cut a similar watermark's detection from 100% to 57.2% in one pass (Krishna et al.). If you're relying on watermarks to prove or disprove authorship, don't.
